definition: Total sale_price from order_items where status is not 'Cancelled' and not 'Returned'.
Total sale_price across all order_items regardless of cancellation or return status.
Net revenue divided by the count of distinct non-cancelled, non-returned orders.
Percentage of order items with status = 'Returned' out of all non-cancelled items.
Percentage of distinct users who placed 2 or more non-cancelled orders out of all users with at least 1 non-cancelled order.
Gross profit is order_items.sale_price minus products.cost for completed/shipped items; gross margin is gross profit divided by sale_price.
formula: SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost) and SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), SUM(oi.sale_price)) * 100
